pages.text: $(italic)$(#6b5a45)Requires the Goety mod.$()$(br2)A mage has to be holding a Goety wand in its main hand before a Goety focus can go into its cast strategy slots. A focus mounted on the wand is never cast — the mage only uses one that has been placed in a strategy slot, and only one focus fits in the whole bar at a time.
